releases.notes:
# 0.0.7.2-alpha
## New Features
* Increased the supported Neoforge version to 26.1.2.108
* Two background music tracks by KiTheAdventurer

## Changes
* The changes to the vision of Premitive Enderman have been reverted to align with the background setting

## Fixes
* The pop-up translation text was incorrectly parsed on the server side
* Monster rooms and amethyst geodes sometimes break the OOTS Laboratory structure
* `EntityFluidInteractionMixin` faild to inject
* The Far Lands biomes cannot be generated correctly on the server side

# 0.0.7.1-alpha
## New Features (Experiental)
* Test Mob

## Changes
* Increased spawn probability of Primitive Enderman
* When an entity rides a vehicle, the triggering of Precision Loss 256 teleportation will be changed to be determined by the speed of the vehicle

# 0.0.7-alpha
## New Features
* Primitive Enderman
  * Ancestor of the Enderman
  * The image is taken from an early version of the Enderman
* Primitive Ender Core
  * Right click to give player _Precision Loss_ effect, which can be overlaid
  * Smash with an anvil to give _Precision Loss_ 255 to the surrounding creatures
* _Precision Loss_ Effect
  * From level 1 to level 10, each level increase will cause the coordinate precision of the entity to lose one binary bit, and at level 6, all decimal parts will be lost
  * Level 255, the entity will be stuck in place and unable to move. When it reaches sufficient speed, it will trigger a teleportation to the Far Lands
* Two new transitional biomes
  * Wall of ice: A frozen biome bordering cold biomes
  * Wall of sand: An incomplete desert themed biome

## New Features (Experiental)
* Ancient Grass Block and Ancient Stone for an upcoming biome
* Invalid Block, an unused block, we will only use it's missingno texture.
 
## Changes
* Improved the shape of Mega Vines.

releases.notes:
## Announcements
Far Lands Traveler now supports Minecraft 26.1.2

## New Features
* Fake chunk, a kind of chunk that has no collision with normal entities.
  * If you walk into a Fake Chunk, you will noclip into solid blocks and eventually fall into the void.
  * Interacting with the blocks in a Fake Chunk is also impossible, unless you are holding an item with specific tag (`desolid_effect_no_effect`).
  * Entities wearing armors with specific tag (`desolid_effect_immune`) are immune to this effect.
  * Entities under specific tag (`desolid_effect_immune`) are immune to this effect.
  * Blocks under specific tag (`desolid_effect_no_effect`) are not affected by this effect.
  * Blocks in Fake Chunks are not affected by explosions.
  * Blocks in Fake Chunks will lose their special effects, for example lava will no longer hurt normal entities.
  * And more features...
* Abandoned Village, a village that comes from old Minecraft. You can go back, but there is no one there anymore.
  * Preset system for Abandoned Village, you can replace the blocks that make up the buildings, just like vanilla Minecraft did for villages in different biomes.

## New Features (Experimental)
* added a `random_factory` density function, which will use a specific `RandomSource` to generate noise maps.
* Stripe Lands, the seventh stage of the Far Lands.

## Fixes
* [FLT-5](https://github.com/SmallmanSeries/FarLandsTraveler/issues/5) 在使用假区块标记器标记的区块中液体仍然有碰撞箱.
* Other issues related to Fake Chunks.
